## Stack and boundaries

- Static Next.js ^16.0.0 / React ^19.2.0; GitHub Pages.
- Google OAuth + private Sheet authority; shared Apps Script receipt/AI service.
- Read-only offline cache; confirmed financial writes use audit receipts and readback.
- Release version comes from the shared version script, not package.json's initial version.
- AI uploads produce reviewed proposals; keys stay in server-side Script properties.
